source.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed Squamous or Non-squamous NSCLC.
prior pathological diagnosis of complex SCLC \[such as mixed SCLC and NSCLC\] or transformed SCLC \[NSCLC to SCLC\] is not allowed
Participants with histologically confirmed advanced/metastatic solid tumors
Metastatic NSCLC (Stage IV), according to American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) 8th edition

Has symptomatic Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases, CNS metastases with hemorrhagic features, CNS metastasis ≥ 1.5 cm, CNS radiation within 7 days prior to first dose, potential need for CNS radiation within the first cycle, or leptomeningeal disease.

Has symptomatic Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases, CNS metastases with hemorrhagic features, CNS metastasis ≥ 1.5 cm, CNS radiation within 7 days prior to first dose, potential need for CNS radiation within the first cycle, or leptomeningeal disease.
Has at least 1 target lesion per RECIST 1.1, as determined by the investigator.
Has an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, with no deterioration in the 2 weeks before first dose.

Participants that had any macromolecular anticancer drug (including immunotherapies such as monoclonal antibodies and bispecific antibodies) within 28 days prior to the first dose of study intervention are excluded.

Any evidence of current Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)/non-infectious pneumonitis OR a prior history of ILD/non-infectious pneumonitis requiring high-dose glucocorticoids OR suspected ILD/non-infectious pneumonitis that cannot be ruled out by imaging.
Participants with moderate to severe pulmonary disease or current clinically significant pulmonary compromise that, in the investigator's judgment, could jeopardize safety or study conduct.

Has received immunosuppressive agents within 30 days prior to first dose of study treatment (or requires long-term (30 days or longer) glucocorticoid therapy). Low-dose corticosteroids (prednisone ≤10 mg/day or equivalent) may be administered.
